column2: In-depth reading and “What the app found”: from the record read to the person records?
column3: In the transcription workshop, “✨ Read the record” first spots a screenshot of an archives website (toolbars, grey edges) and offers “✂ Crop to the text”: only the page is read (or only the areas you drew ▭). If the text read is uncertain, “✂ Crop and read again” or “🔍 Try in-depth reading”: an open vision model (Qwen3-VL, Apache 2.0) running on your computer with Ollama, installed once (More ▾ → “🔍 In-depth reading…”); both readings are shown side by side and you keep the better one. Nothing goes on the Internet except the model download. Then “🧭 Spot”, then “✓ Add to the family tree…”: the app shows the event, the people with their role (spouses, parents, witnesses, godfather…), age, occupation and residence; for each one “🔗 Link”, “⇆ Compare” (the record and the profile side by side), “＋ Create”, “Ignore” or “Witness only”. The source (archives, register, reference, image n / N) is prefilled. Everything goes in at once, family links included, and “↶ Undo” reverses it all.
